title: 3D Educational Animations
html:
Introducing a new animation series designed to support educators in enhancing their curriculum! The Academy has developed highly realistic virtual visualizations of foundational periodontal concepts that closely reflect clinical practice.

New animations will be released every few months, covering a wide range of topics—from Periodontal Anatomy and Peri-implant Tissues to Measuring Gingival and Tooth Mobility, and more.

Thank you to those who contributed to bringing these educational tools to life:
Drs. Satish Kumar, Jennifer Bain, Alex Gillone, Kian Kar, Lea Hachem, Erin Lee, Alon Frydman, and Clark Chen.
